description: Adapts the Time-Series Momentum (TSMOM) and Mean Reversion (TSMR) signals from the Oxford Man Institute paper on Deep Learning for Delta-Neutral Straddles to A-share equities. Implements volatility targeting and risk controls (trailing stop, max drawdown) within the OnData loop, adhering to A-share trading rules (T+1, fee models, lot sizes).
risk_controls: Max Drawdown: Liquidate all positions if portfolio drawdown exceeds 20%.
Trailing Stop: Liquidate position if price drops 10% from highest price since entry.
Volatility Targeting: Scale position size inversely by 20-day realized volatility.
blocked_reason: data_coverage=0.0% < 20% threshold (>80% missing from tushare/open sources)
